descriptionChirho: The numeral 'one' used as a cardinal number, indicating a single entity or expressing unity, across all genders and cases.
Used with ordinal force meaning 'first,' especially in temporal expressions such as 'the first day of the week' (μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων).
Distributive use meaning 'each one' or 'one by one,' expressing individual distribution across members of a group.
Used in correlative constructions meaning 'the other (one),' paired with another εἷς or ἄλλος to distinguish between two parties.
